evidence.quote: I want to turn to three proposals currently being debated in policy circles
determining the most effective and efficient ways to deal with short-term funding markets, often characterized as the shadow banking system, that are inherently subject to runs.
For the proposal to reenact Glass-Steagall, that perspective suggested the potential for considerable social costs.
